result.markdown: --- title: "Command reference" --- This page is generated from the command registry, like `/help` in the console. ## Console commands | Command | Description | |---|---| | /ai [question] | Toggle the AI mode, or ask one question | | /ai_script <name> "<description>" | Generate a script from a description with the AI | | /context | Edit the user context file (context.md) for the AI | | /gen_ai_doc | Regenerate docs/ai/agent.md from the commands and docstrings | | /init [folder] | Summarize every signal for the AI context | | /model [anthropic|openai|ollama] [model] | Show or choose the AI provider and model | | /acq --server HOST --network NET --station STA [--channels ...] [--duration s] [--load] | SeedLink acquisition to miniSEED (see /acq --help) | | /rt --server HOST --network NET --station STA --channels FHZ [--mode stats|fft|dsp] | Real-time statistics, FFT or PSD of SeedLink streams (see /rt --help) | | /clear | Clear the screen | | /config [section.key=value] | Show the configuration or change a value for this session | | /debug on|off | Show full tracebacks on errors | | /help [command] | List the commands, or describe one | | /quit | Quit onthesignal | | /report [n|all] [title=...] [render=true] [formats=html,pdf] | Quarto report of the last results | | /results | List the results of the session | | /batch <analysis|script> <files...> [key=value...] [out=results.csv] | Run an analysis or a script on many files | | /edit_script <name> | Create or edit a script with the configured editor (vi, nano) | | /run_script <name> <S...> [key=value...] | Run a user script on signals | | /scripts | List the user scripts | | /export <S> <file> | Export a signal (miniSEED, text, CSV) | | /info <S> | Show every parameter of a signal | | /list | List the signals of the session | | /load <file> [key=value...] | Load a miniSEED or text file | | /make_noise [rms] [color] [bits] [key=value...] | Create a random test noise (ideal N-bit digitizer) | | /make_sine [frequency] [ratio] [bits] [key=value...] | Create a test sine (ideal N-bit digitizer) | | /rename <old> <new> | Rename a signal | | /rm <S> [S...] | Remove signals from the session | | /show <S> [units=counts] [save=file.png] | Plot the time series of a signal | ## Analyses Each analysis is available as `/name S1 key=value...` and as the Python function `name(S1, key=value...)`. Without parameters, the `/` command opens a form. ### `delay50(S1, S2, ...)` Delay between two signals at 50 % of their transitions. | Parameter | Default | Unit | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `edge` | `rising` | | Edges measured | | `level` | `0.5` | | Threshold between the low and high levels (0.5 = 50 %) | | `levels` | `histogram` | | Low/high levels: histogram modes (oscilloscope
